newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope welcomes Guatemalan peace accord.
newsitem.headline: Pope welcomes Guatemalan peace accord.

text.p: Pope John Paul wished Guatemala a future of peace and progress on Wednesday following a recent peace accord.

"I congratulate all of Guatemala for the signing of the peace treaty which ended so many years of war and I hope this beloved nation enjoys a future of peace and spiritual and material progress in which the rights of all are respected," the Pope said during his weekly general audience at the Vatican.
He made the remarks in Spanish while greeting a group of Guatemalan pilgrims.
The Guatemalan government and rebels of the leftist Guatemalan National Revolutionary Unit signed a historic peace treaty on December 29, ending 36 years of civil war.
